steps: Open app -> Complete Onboarding -> Register Account
Select default Madhhab preference (e.g., Maliki / Hanafi)
Input total estate gross value, funeral cost, and debts
Select surviving heirs (Spouse, Sons, Daughters, Mother, Father)
Tap Calculate -> Review Faraid fraction distribution
Log in -> Tap Zakat Card on Dashboard
Review live gold & silver Nisab rates
Input liquid cash, gold weight, stocks, and business assets
View Zakat Due summary (2.5%) -> Save calculation to History
